author: Zegita
body: Like the title says, myself and a lot of other people just want to know from on a percentage wise - what is the status of Atlas? Is it close or far from being complete? I know the devs are doing a brilliant job but it would really be helpful if you could brief the community so that we don't start losing hope (most of us still believe in you guys but we haven't had any proper announcements yet). Just give us a number e.g 50% 70% 90% and tell us what you guys need to finish in Atlas so we can understand how long we have to wait. Don't do an OCN and keep us in the dark and drive everything away please.

replies.author: Tazz
replies.body: Although I'm not a Dev, Atlas serves its purpose and at the minute it can manage games, like it is suppose to. Just participate on the beta tests and you should get a rough idea of the percentage. I doubt you're going to be told a number, they're working on it and they have been for a while. It's not easy.

replies.author: keenanjt
replies.body:
Along with Atlas we must convert our plugins that manage statistic and session tracking, credits, server network management and much more. This is what we are working on currently. Can't give a date, sorry!

If I were to put a percentage on it, 80% to 90%.
